articles.title: Bolivia weighs adding Tether's USDT to its national payments system
articles.snippet: Crypto usage has spiked in the country, with transaction volumes hitting $430 million in the year after the central bank removed restrictions in mid-2024.

articles.title: Tom Lee's BitMine ether holdings rise to 5.77 million tokens, or 4.8% of total supply
articles.snippet: The company expanded its ETH treasury while Chairman Tom Lee pointed to Robinhood Chain's rapid growth on Ethereum.

articles.title: SBI Holdings' blockchain initiative pivots to Solana for tokenization, stablecoin issuance
articles.snippet: The SBI Solana Global joint venture now includes the Solana Foundation, the Swiss organization that oversees the layer-1 network.

articles.title: Profit-taking, MidEast hostilities drag crypto lower after bullish week
articles.snippet: Crypto's weekend gains gave way to a Monday selloff as Middle East tensions resurfaced, South Korea's Kospi lost 9.2% and $253 million in leveraged positions were wiped out.

articles.title: Hyundai completes USDT treasury settlement pilot between US and Mexico
articles.snippet: Hyundai completed a proof-of-concept using Tether's USDT to settle a cross-border treasury transfer between its US and Mexican subsidiaries, highlighting growing enterprise interest in stablecoin-based payments.
